Surface: Lattice type. gyroid: gyroid; schwarzp: Schwarz P (cubic pores); diamond: diamond lattice.
Frequency: Lattice cells per world unit. Higher = finer lattice.
Thickness: Wall thickness of the lattice in field units. Higher = thicker walls.
Boundradius: Radius of the sphere the lattice is clipped to, in world units. 0 = infinite lattice.
Color: Albedo colour at one end of the blend across the surface.
Color2: Albedo colour at the other end of the blend across the surface.
